rules.chapter_units: per construction gene of the chapter, its simulable genes-v2 entities whose ids meet the chapter's OMIM ids, else its main entity
rules.chapters: usable chapters in priority order (P1..P4, then priority_rank), 10 per shard, ids C001...
rules.excluded: evaluation genes and every entity sharing an id with a litpanel-split-v3 disease; genes whose main entity does
rules.paper_units: every simulable genes-v2 entity of the paper's genes
rules.papers: selected papers in papers.tsv order, 12 per shard, ids P001...
